raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer did not follow the Planner’s directive to open authoritative sources and extract specific per-kWh pollutant data. Instead, it surfaced an auto-generated search-assist snippet implying natural gas yields the largest air-quality gains, without verification or synthesis. This introduced misleading information and led to repetitive, unproductive search loops rather than compiling evidence that clearly shows wind has the lowest operational emissions and life-cycle impacts, thereby risking a wrong conclusion.
